in_sanskrit.name: Kano
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Born from the river
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kano एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kan', meaning 'blue' or 'dark'. This name is believed to be given to children born near or by a river.

in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Born from the river
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kano हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kan', meaning 'blue' or 'dark'. This name is believed to be given to children born near or by a river.
